اقتعدا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَعَدَا (iqtaʕadā) /iq.ta.ʕa.daː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# اُقْتُعِدَا (uqtuʕidā) /uq.tu.ʕi.daː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# اِقْتَعِدَا (iqtaʕidā) /iq.ta.ʕi.daː/: second-person dual imperative of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
